title: AI Interviewer Rating Agent
shortDescription: A practicum project for Roblox: an AI agent that evaluates interviewer performance across 13 rubrics.
problem: Roblox needed a reliable way to see whether interviewers performed well during their interviews.
approach: As a practicum project for Roblox, I built an AI agent that evaluates interviewer performance across 13 rubrics, turning interview sessions into structured, comparable results.
result: The agent gives Roblox a structured picture of interviewer performance across all 13 rubrics instead of relying on manual review.

title: Formula 1 Driver Performance Analysis
shortDescription: A Python project investigating what drives Formula 1 driver performance using statistical modeling.
problem: What actually drives Formula 1 driver performance? The project set out to test hypotheses instead of assuming.
approach: Used Python with pandas and statistical modeling to investigate hypotheses about the factors behind driver performance.
result: The analysis was well received, earning positive feedback from the professor and peers.

title: Ripple Realty Group Website
shortDescription: A real estate company website I built end to end, serving the Silicon Valley and Boston markets.
problem: The company needed a professional website to present its listings and turn visitors into client inquiries.
approach: I mapped the site structure, designed the property listing and contact pages, and implemented the page layouts in HTML/CSS and JavaScript. After launch, I used site analytics and user feedback to simplify the navigation, restructure the above-the-fold content and listing cards, and compress image assets.
result: Faster page load times and more contact form submissions.
